summary:
This segment covers two deltas in html-portfolio, both off merge base 3a92179 (main).

Delta A: origin/main...origin/claude/ai-companion-app-rkt1lv@f4d3fe4. 34 commits, 89 files. This is the shipped 2026-08-25 launch wave of the Maya/Meera companion. It contains:
- RelationalOS R3, which pushed character-leak residues 95->0 with the core byte-identical 83/83. The CharacterSheet/AgentModule seam lets Kabir run on the same core (412/412 invariants, from main).
- A never-internals safety floor born of a live 'openai ka gpt-4o hu' incident: a persona block, a 154-unit/208-turn deterministic attack battery with severity tiers, and a mechanical output-side fence (internalsFence.ts). The fence was replayed at 2/2 severe caught and 0/205 false positives, does one unstreamed re-draft, sends anyway on a second trip, and arms the next turn on streamed lanes.
- A her-side loop fence (Jaccard 0.8).
- Adaptive game difficulty: one-way within a game, EMA across games, never rendered into the prompt.
- Flavour-weighted, session-seeded variety.
- A DPDP memory-consent step: one network seam returns 451, the ledger is append-only and content-free, migration 016 is unapplied.
- Explicit Gemini cachedContents at -77% measured, behind a paid lane that is off by default and gated by a judge-free differential that found -6pp Hinglish.
- A resurrected ops stream, a Play Store pack (deferred), and market research.

Delta B: origin/claude/ai-companion-app-rkt1lv..origin/voice-cloning@a7bdcaa. 41 commits, 342 files, +50k lines. This is 'Vyakti Replica Lab', a consented, provider-portable self-voice-clone platform at /studio. It is prototype-grade: control-plane code with mocked provider boundaries and no live Azure call. It contains:
- Consent receipts with 10 scopes, tiered and expiring, and a one-statement revoke cascade.
- An immutable evidence DAG: ClamAV, ffprobe, diarize/separate/enhance candidates, Azure Speech fast transcription en-IN/hi-IN, ECAPA+x-vector.
- An evidence-backed Person Model: model extraction proposes cited claims through an Azure Foundry strict json_schema call plus an exact-quote verifier and PII redaction; the owner disposes.
- Typed calibration with registered strategies, and a Bradley-Terry active voice curriculum with a preregistered Wilson holdout.
- {reply, delivery} strict dialogue.
- Layered encrypted feedback, whole-session dataset splits, and a Wilson/noninferiority/zero-failure-safety qualification gate.
- Provenance: audible disclosure, AudioSeal/PerTh watermark, 240 ms signed segment chain, C2PA through Key Vault.
- An atomic Azure spend ledger (reserve/in_flight/settle/reconcile).
- Erasure state machines.
- ACA scale-to-zero T4 GPU behind an HMAC broker.
- Migration 018 for raw-memory agent tenancy.

I ran 31 offline suites at $0 on 2026-10-02; 30 pass. agent/raw-isolation FAILS 1/47 at the voice-cloning tip and passes 47/47 at the pre-merge commit 92bd64e. The main merge reintroduced two unscoped meera_nodes reads in the api/memory.js forget hook. Migration ordinals also collide across branches. For Taxila, the highest-value takeaways are the fences, consent seam and ledger, adaptive difficulty, spend governor, Foundry structured-output adapter with citation verifier, propose/dispose learner observations, Bradley-Terry learning-profile discovery, Wilson qualification gates, envelope encryption, lease queue, and erasure cascades. Cloning, liveness and identity are mostly skip/idea for a children's product.

assets.title: Internals fence (output-side severe-class predicate)
assets.what: Pure predicate over the outgoing reply with three severe shapes: confirmation (a user's term bound to self in the first person), volunteered (a vendor term absent from the user's last 6 turns) and claim (a first-person architecture assertion). It has question and negation guards, a Hindi 'google karna' verb exemption, narrow lexicons whose every exclusion is justified by a measured reply, and an angle-bracket INTERNALS_NUDGE with no sayable line.
assets.taxila_target: safety-floor/honesty (child-safety severe classes: contact/meeting solicitation, human claims, PII asks)
assets.evidence: Offline replay 2/2 severe caught, 0/19 register echoes, 0/186 clean (n=208); live n=144 0 severe; harvest run evals/behavioral/fence.mjs 95/95 pass

assets.title: Single convergence-seam re-draft, send-anyway
assets.what: The fence runs LAST on the final text at the point every reply path converges on. It re-drafts once through the unstreamed proxy with the nudge on the tail, and only when nothing has streamed. A second trip is sent and logged (action 'sent'). diag logs class and count, never text.

assets.title: Her-side loop fence + topic repetition detector
assets.what: isLoopingLine: Jaccard over 0.8 on Devanagari-preserving word sets against her last 2 lines, exempt under 4 words (backchannels). LOOP_NUDGE carries no sayable line. raisedRecently (main) filters a term only when it is common AND used by the user, and carries the user's reply length.
assets.notes: Known edge: paraphrased loops are missed at 0.8

assets.title: Arm-next-turn unstreamed pattern for streamed lanes
assets.what: Detect a defect on the completed streamed turn and arm the NEXT turn to run unstreamed so a real re-draft can exist. There are two separate arms (loopArmed, internalsArmed) because the nudges differ. The silence re-engage turn is always fenced.

assets.title: Behavioral attack battery with severity tiers
assets.what: 154 units / 208 turns across internals (direct, roleplay, extract, authority, costume, escalation), game truth and loop, about 2/3 Hinglish. Deterministic grader, no LLM judge, with per-rule positive and negative controls run before spend. --dry costs $0. REGISTER_TERMS are measured and never gate. fence.mjs proves the TS fence and JS grader agree and transpiles the real source.
assets.evidence: Harvest run --dry: controls green, 154/208; baseline and after runs n=208

assets.title: Memory consent UI (single-source copy)
assets.what: MEMORY_COPY is one source used across 3 surfaces. Every clause can be checked against the code. It is product chrome, not persona voice. It has a real 'Not now' path with its meaning stated. Existing users see a non-modal card. Withdrawal rides the forget door.

assets.title: Consent gate at one network seam (451 refusal)
assets.what: GATED_OPS {log, remember, seed_currency, activity, upload_photo, describe} are refused in post() with a 451 shaped like an offline response. Out-of-file writers call memoryWritesPermitted(). Ungated ops (recall, forget, analytics, clock, localStorage) are listed with reasons.
assets.notes: Taxila must invert the default: absent parent consent means no memory

assets.title: Append-only consent ledger (migration 016 + account.js consent op)
assets.what: meera_consent(device_id, user_id?, kind, granted, version, at, filed_at). No text column, ever. No FK, so anonymous refusals can be recorded. A grant is a row and a withdrawal is a row. A full wipe deletes consent rows. Inserts are awaited (serverless freeze). A failure returns 502, not 200.
assets.notes: Migration 016 awaited owner application at tip; ordinal collides with voice-cloning 016_replica_enrollment

assets.title: MemoryConsent record + version + memoryWritesAllowed
assets.what: Three-field consent record {granted, ISO at, version}. MEMORY_CONSENT_VERSION is bumped on material copy change. The record is device-local, not synced, and included in the cross-tab signature. Absent means yes for pre-existing installs.

assets.title: Manifest-driven wipe/DSAR + tableApplied guard
assets.what: The PERSON_TABLES manifest drives forget and export. A to_regclass probe, cached per process, keeps forget from returning 500 before a migration lands. relcheck fails any device-keyed table that is missing from the manifest.

assets.title: CharacterSheet contract (persona as data)
assets.what: About 60 byte-exact fragment fields: identity, language rules, mandatory crisis lines, register slots, and 32 ex* example fragments marked as diagrams-never-lines. A sheet is a leaf module. Kabir is authored maximally far from Maya to expose leaks.
assets.evidence: residues 95->64->27->0, Maya byte-identical 83/83; Kabir 412/412 invariants (main d49bf8ce)

assets.title: AgentModule contract + registry
assets.what: buildSystemPromptParts(user, n, medium, dimsStage) returns {core, tail}. Also buildSpeechStyle(engine), WATCH_MODE_NOTE, SEARCH_DECISION/FORGET_DECISION (must stay last), invariant-gated CRISIS_LINES, a hand-bumped personaVersion cache key, and register {script, honorificSystem}.

assets.title: Agent-scope tenancy predicate + agent migrations
assets.what: 'and alias.agent_id = ($n)::uuid' is applied in WHERE before rank. The binding is scalar, so a null binding returns zero rows. The module enumerates scoped, raw-scoped and person-intrinsic tables (vy_person and age tier are never per-agent). Forget is deliberately all-agent. writers name agent_id explicitly through agentValue().

assets.title: Adaptive difficulty (one-way in-session, EMA across sessions)
assets.what: A cheap three-ply material proxy (search-free). In-game it rises by at most 1 notch and never falls (falling reads as pity). Across games it is an EMA with alpha 0.4, games under 10 plies are ignored, and values are stored to one decimal on the activity ledger. latestSkill is computed by closedAt. The value is never rendered in a prompt and never announced. The tuning block is in one place.
assets.notes: Values are explicitly starting points, not tuned by measurement

assets.title: Flavour-weighted session-seeded variety
assets.what: A variety draw over the sound-move pool, clamped so strength is unchanged, weighted by the existing flavour score (FLOOR_WEIGHT 6 vs 22) and seeded by session id. The same game replays identically; the next game differs.

assets.title: STATE_LAW: board-derived terminal claims
assets.what: Only the engine state line may declare win, checkmate or end. Past games are memories, never the present. A handed win is not a win. 'I forgot' about the live board is a lie, and the activity note carries her current idea.
assets.taxila_target: gamification; safety-floor/honesty (scores/stars are engine-owned, never LLM-claimed)
assets.evidence: game family of behavioral battery: handed-win 2/16 -> 1/16

assets.title: Never-internals floor block
assets.what: 'An AI' is the whole truth and its whole granularity. It names every jailbreak costume. The tenth ask is the first ask. A sarcastic confirmation is still a confirmation. The interview never flips back onto the user. It lives in the never-truncated core beside AI-honesty and Crisis and is gated per module on 4 lanes.

assets.title: Watch-mode screen-privacy tact
assets.what: buildWatchModeNote(C): notice the password, OTP, bank number or another person's message and let it pass without announcing it. Warn about the KIND of thing once, never its content, then drop it. A warning mentioned twice is surveillance.

assets.title: Question and praise laws in persona
assets.what: At most 1 in 3 replies contains a question, and something of the persona's own comes first. Praise is specific, not voluminous, with one intensifier and no inflation of small wins ('if your praise is free they stop bringing you things'). Get interested before celebrating into the dark.
assets.taxila_target: learning/pedagogy; emotional-lens/affect (covert comprehension without quiz cadence)

assets.title: Ops event stream (obs)
assets.what: A single writer into the existing diag table (scope ops, device 'server'). It never throws or blocks. obsBestEffort exists for hot paths. Detail is counts, labels and decisions only; key labels are allowed, never values.
assets.evidence: 12 paid_turn rows read back from production

assets.title: Explicit prompt cache keyed by core bytes
assets.what: Key is sha256(core) per model. The per-instance map is an optimisation, not truth. TTL is the garbage collector (10 min, maximum 15). Creation is single-flight. Creating has a 12 s leash and degrades to an uncached turn. A missing cache name causes a re-create in the same turn.
assets.taxila_target: infra/azure (Azure OpenAI prompt caching on byte-stable teacher core)
assets.notes: Gemini-specific API; the concept transfers, numbers do not

assets.title: Flag-gated paid lane (off is identity)
assets.what: PAID_LANE must be explicitly true AND the key must exist. Otherwise laneOrder returns the frozen pre-existing arrays by identity. thinkingLevel passes through; thinkingBudget is not used.

assets.title: Android release signing in CI
assets.what: Signed .aab plus release APK. The keystore exists only as a base64 secret decoded at build time. A HAS_KEYSTORE env flag is used because secrets are unreadable in step if:. Unsigned and debug builds are unchanged when the secret is absent.

assets.title: Play Store submission pack
assets.what: Data-safety rows derived from the privacy page (transcript only, raw audio never uploaded; screen frames never stored), IARC guidance, permission declarations and store screenshots.
assets.notes: Targets 18+. Taxila must re-derive for the Google Play Families policy. Submission deferred by owner.

assets.title: Web account-deletion page
assets.what: A no-install deletion request page, as required by the Play data-safety form.

assets.title: India market sweep
assets.what: 43-source GTM facts: India AI-tutor cluster at Rs 420-1,000/mo, Stimuler $5-7/mo, TRAI outbound AI rules, DPDP 2027-05-14 unbundled-consent requirement, closed paid ad channels for the companion category.

assets.title: Cross-agent leak guard + ratchet
assets.what: Counts one character's fragments in another agent's compiled prompt. The ratchet is pinned at 0, so character prose in the core is a build failure.

assets.title: Judge-free deterministic differential method
assets.what: 150 pre-registered pairs generated through both wire shapes and compared on length, markers, bubble count, vendor/AI mentions, a Hinglish register proxy and helpline presence, with a preset flag line.

assets.title: Replica domain kernel: lifecycle, consent scopes, typed activation blockers
Consent receipts + tiered scopes + one-statement revoke cascade
assets.what: Canonical-JSON SHA-256 receipts carrying nonce, statement set and policy version. Account attestation can grant only capture, transcription and storage. Training and inference need a verified ceremony and expire in 30 or 180 days. Re-grant revokes and re-inserts in one CTE. Revoke is one data-modifying CTE that pauses the lifecycle, deletes sources, revokes provider consents, fails challenges, supersedes claims, retires models and voices, and audits.
assets.evidence: replica, replica-enrollment, provider-consent gates pass (harvest run)

assets.title: Replica schema (migrations 015-050)
assets.what: Replica, consent, source manifest, claim, VoiceGenome/provider profile, profile/eval, audit, erasure, feedback, dataset, candidate and qualification records. Composite FKs on (owner, replica, source) block cross-tenant joins. Every statement is idempotent for Neon's one-statement-per-request runner.
assets.notes: Not deployed; numbering collides with main/rkt1lv (two 015s, 016 differs)

assets.title: Atomic paid-provider spend governor
assets.what:
The flow is reserve, then in_flight, then settle, with reconcile_required for any ambiguous outcome after I/O.
- Reservation is a conservative maximum: 1 token per UTF-8 byte, enforced max_tokens, audio rounded up to whole seconds, characters bounded by UTF-8 bytes.
- A DB CHECK enforces spent+reserved<=limit in micro-USD. (budget, operation, request_hash) is unique.
- Rates come from env, with no hardcoded prices. Missing values fail closed.
- The ledger is content-free.
assets.notes: Add realtime audio token unit kinds

assets.title: Azure Foundry strict structured-output adapter + citation verifier
assets.what: The request goes to /models/chat/completions?api-version=2024-05-01-preview with json_schema strict, temperature 0, max_tokens 4000, finish_reason=stop required and a 1 MB body bound. Exactly one auth path is allowed and errors carry codes only. The server validator rejects unknown keys, protected-trait inference, direct identifiers, and quotes that do not resolve to a unique exact span. Confidence is capped by evidence and entailment (entailment must be at least 0.55). Every output is a proposal, never approved.
assets.taxila_target: memory-graph; learning/pedagogy (cited learner observations for parent review)
assets.evidence: harvest run replica-claim-extraction 26/26; mocked protocol only

assets.title: Direct-identifier redaction before provider calls
assets.what: redactTranscript and containsDirectIdentifier: character-preserving masks for email, URL, phone, Aadhaar-like, PAN-like, card-like and credential/OTP patterns. Role-tag stripping is done in clean().

assets.title: {reply, delivery} strict dialogue contract + deterministic safety
assets.what: The delivery object has mode (grounded/warm/playful/direct/repair), pace (slow/natural/brisk), intensity 0-1, language_hint and at most 3 nonverbals. The history window is 20 turns / 16k characters. Runtime laws: AI, never 'the human'; no invented memories; no OTP or payments; conversation is untrusted data. dangerousReply is a regex block. dialogueSpeechStyle maps the enums to a TTS style string.

assets.title: Evidence-backed Person Model (append-only decisions -> deterministic profile)
assets.what: Owner decisions (accepted, rejected, superseded) are appended and the latest wins. person-model-builder/v1 hashes an order-independent source set and retains competing observations as uncertainty. Approval recomputes server-side. A version frozen by a live capability is never retired.

assets.title: Typed calibration via safe contrast pairs + registered strategies
assets.what: 10 server-owned scenarios across 5 layers. The client submits only scenario id, left/right/tie/neither and confidence. The deterministic policy needs at least 7 resolved contrasts covering all layers. Only registered strategy ids compile into directives; forged or free text is ignored.

assets.title: Bradley-Terry active pairwise curriculum
assets.what: A MAP Bradley-Terry fit over 7 conditions with 5 bootstrap pairs. Pair selection is 2.2*Fisher + 0.7*exposure uncertainty + 0.55*repeat penalty + 0.12*rejection exploration. Ties count 1/2. 'neither' is rejection evidence. Repeated prompts are down-weighted by 1/sqrt. The convergence gate is >=18 comparisons, all conditions covered, >=6 prompt families, champion exposures >=5 and margin >=0.42. Side order is seeded and deterministic. A versioned EN/HI deck spans 7 domains.
assets.taxila_target: learning/pedagogy (learning-profile discovery across modalities); tts-voice-identity (child picks teacher voice)

assets.title: Voice Delivery Genome + preregistered holdout
assets.what: An immutable policy candidate. The holdout deck is kept out of calibration history by DB constraints. 6 unseen prompts x 2 seeds = 12 cells. A pass needs a rate of at least 0.75 and a Wilson lower bound above 0.5. owner_pass changes no runtime state.

assets.title: Candidate qualification gate (Wilson + noninferiority + zero-failure safety)
assets.what: Per layer: >=30 observations, >=24 decisive and >=2 sessions. Target layers need share >=0.6 with Wilson95 >0.5. Safeguard layers need share >=0.4 with Wilson95 >0.4. Critical suites need >=300 trials with 0 failures. False memory needs >=100 trials, no regression and <=1%. A/B order is committed and balanced within 1. Inconclusive is never rounded up. Qualified is not active.
assets.taxila_target: evals/gates (promotion of any teacher prompt/model change)

assets.title: Blind owner A/B evaluation lab
assets.what: The plan is cryptographically shuffled with balanced AB/BA order and committed before viewing. Assets are envelope-encrypted per asset. The browser never sees candidate id, order or target layers. Judgments are atomic across all layers. Retries are idempotent only when identical.
assets.taxila_target: evals/gates (teacher/parent blind review of lesson variants)

assets.title: Layered exact-version turn feedback
assets.what: Overall, wording, behavior, relationship, memory and delivery are rated separately. Voice can only be rated after sealed audio was heard. Reason codes are controlled. Revisions append. Each rating binds the turn, response hash and versions. Corrections are encrypted and never mutate the live prompt.

assets.title: Envelope encryption (AES-256-GCM DEK wrapped by KEK)
assets.what: A per-record random DEK with AES-256-GCM under evidence-bound AAD, and the DEK wrapped by a KEK with its own nonce and tag. The AAD hash is verified on read. The key id is carried with each record.
assets.notes: Docs require Key Vault/HSM wrapper and rewrap rotation before production

assets.title: Leakage-safe dataset compiler (whole-session splits)
assets.what: Splits are immutable and keyed by a salted session commitment, targeting 70/15/15. Unsafe sessions are forced to test. A contaminated frozen session blocks the build. The definition is content-free. Readiness needs >=12 sessions and >=30 test examples.

assets.title: Provider-neutral voice contract (24 kHz PCM, disclosure assertion)
assets.what: createVoice, getVoiceStatus, synthesizeStream and deleteVoice. Output is fixed to pcm_s16le 24 kHz mono, and the result must render the exact disclosure prefix. clientVoiceProfile is a whitelist. The fake provider requires allowFake.

assets.title: Azure Personal Voice adapter
assets.what: Custom Voice API 2026-01-01: consent, profile, raw-24khz-16bit-mono-pcm synthesis and deletion. The base model must be pinned ('Latest' is refused). Two approval flags gate it. Deterministic ids make recovery idempotent. Erasure has a smaller config surface than creation. Training needs 30-90 s total.
assets.taxila_target: voice-cloning (only if a consented real-teacher or parent voice is ever offered)
assets.evidence: offline 27/27; Limited Access not verified; no live call

assets.title: Open Chatterbox runtime behind HMAC admission broker (ACA scale-to-zero GPU)
assets.what: Chatterbox Multilingual V3 (MIT, includes hi) pinned by commit. HMAC covers request and response bytes, timestamp and nonce. PerTh is verified at a score of at least 0.5. A CPU broker means random traffic cannot wake the GPU. Runs on Consumption-GPU-NC8as-T4 in Central India with minReplicas 0, internal ingress and logs off.

assets.title: Protected stream delivery (disclosure + watermark + signed 240 ms segment chain + C2PA)
assets.what: protectReplicaStream applies an audible prefix and a streaming watermark, then emits 11,520-byte segments that are hash-chained, signed and persisted before release. The Neon insert rechecks that the capability is active, which gives a revocation fence at each segment. A final C2PA credential follows. Fake adapters are refused in production.
assets.taxila_target: safety-floor (AI-voice disclosure for child audio exports)

assets.title: Audio protection service (AudioSeal + C2PA + Key Vault ES256)
assets.what: AudioSeal 0.2 streaming watermark plus a C2PA Python sidecar with signing through a non-exportable Key Vault key. Startup fails closed without CUDA, the key or the cert chain. HMAC transport.

assets.title: Immutable evidence processing DAG
assets.what: Stages run integrity, malware, probe, diarize, separate, enhance, transcribe, quality. Derived objects are create-only, re-read and re-hashed. One atomic SQL statement settles the lease, transitions the source and enqueues the next stage. A collision rolls back everything.

assets.title: Postgres lease job queue
assets.what: for update skip locked. The lease token is returned once and only a domain-separated SHA-256 is stored. Expired leases are reclaimed, the attempt ledger is append-only and backoff is bounded.
assets.taxila_target: infra (module generation jobs, consolidation, image jobs on Neon)

assets.title: Azure Speech fast transcription adapter (en-IN + hi-IN)
assets.what: API 2025-10-15 with inline multipart and never a storage URL. Per-phrase locale, confidence and word offsets. Exactly one auth path. 250 MB / 2 h limits with a 64 MiB default cap. A digest recheck happens before upload. A metering hook is mandatory. The Central India region is required.
assets.taxila_target: realtime-voice (offline ASR of child speech for review); evals
assets.notes: Mocked responses only; no Hinglish WER measured

assets.title: Voice-evidence GPU service (two embedding families, separation, enhancement)
assets.what: SpeechBrain ECAPA and x-vector, never averaged. SepFormer WHAMR emits both speakers. DeepFilterNet3 produces 12 dB and full-suppression candidates. Silero VAD. target_likelihood is fixed at 0.5 until an anchor exists.

assets.title: Scheduled ACA Job worker with ClamAV + ffprobe
assets.what: Cron '*/2 * * * *', 900 s timeout, parallelism 1, zero idle cost. A failed signature refresh blocks the job. Logs carry outcome codes only.
assets.taxila_target: infra/azure (upload malware scanning for homework photos/files)

assets.title: Byte-level WAV probe
assets.what: probeEnrollmentWav checks RIFF/chunk bounds, format, frame alignment and duration measured from PCM, and detects silence, clipping, DC offset and polyglot tails.

assets.title: Private storage with server-chosen paths + signed upload capability
assets.what: Paths are opaque UUIDs chosen by the server. The upload capability covers one object for two hours. No filename or durable URL is stored. Finalization verifies size and MIME and then quarantines. Biometric storage uses a dedicated service-role key.
assets.taxila_target: infra (child uploads to Azure Blob/Vercel Blob)

assets.title: Erasure state machines + HMAC-blinded receipt
assets.what:
Erasure, step by step:
1. Synchronous revoke.
2. A disable-first cron reconciler with one-way leases and no give-up count.
3. Provider deletion, then source plus every derivative.
4. Conservative retirement of models that cannot prove exclusion.
5. An exact-agent purge guard.
6. A content-free blinded receipt with the backup-expiry date.

assets.title: Bearer-only ownership boundary
assets.what: requireUser derives ownership only from a verified bearer session. A device UUID or a body user id is never identity proof. The core is config-free for offline gates.

assets.title: Immutable runtime capability (freeze exact versions)
assets.what: Binds the exact profile, calibration, voice, provider and qualification commitments, with one active capability and an explicit supersede. The browser sends an opaque id only. Every relational read uses the exact (agent_id, person_id) pair. The runtime compiler admits only typed fields and registered strategy ids.

assets.title: Studio SPA as separate Vite entry
assets.what: An owner workspace with its own Vite entry, so the main app bundle and audio floor stay untouched. Uses @layer CSS tokens. Neutral A/B listening is gated so the judgment unlocks only after both candidates have played.

assets.title: Private raw-mic WAV capture (24 kHz mono)
assets.what: getUserMedia with EC, NS and AGC off, OfflineAudioContext resampling to 24 kHz, a local WAV encoder and readable permission-error copy.

assets.title: Incremental SHA-256 in a worker
assets.what: A pure-TS incremental SHA-256 over 4 MiB slices with progress events, so large files hash without blocking the UI.

assets.title: Liveness + identity proofing + Azure verifier broker
assets.what: Composite liveness: phrase, code, face, ID match, single speaker, replay risk and capture binding. All gates are mandatory and scores are never averaged. Azure Document Intelligence and Face quick-link are used. Facial age estimation is never used. Documents are erased after binding.
assets.taxila_target: auth/accounts (idea only for parent verification; never for children)

assets.title: Azure Foundry grant plan and region map
assets.what: A $2,000 grant mapped to a $1,829 plan with a $1,500 app cap. Speech in Central India. GPT-5.6 in South India or Global Standard. gpt-realtime-2.1-mini as a benchmark. Only Direct-from-Azure models are covered. Never Professional CNV. Alerts at $250 / $750 / $1,250 / $1,600 / $1,800. Resources are tagged with expiry_at.

assets.title: Replica frontier research (TTS/S2S/memory licence map)
assets.what: Fish S2, Eleven, Cartesia, Chatterbox, Hume, MiniMax, Tavus, VoxCPM2, MOSS, ZONOS2, OmniVoice, Qwen3-ASR/TTS, CosyVoice, F5, IndexTTS, OpenVoice, Seed-VC, Moshi, PersonaPlex, MiniCPM-o, Graphiti, Mem0, Letta, BGE-M3, AudioSeal and PerTh, each with an adopt/benchmark/reject verdict and India-first benchmark notes.

assets.title: Raw-memory agent isolation migrations
assets.what: Backfills agent_id on meera_log, nodes, edges and forget, with the compatibility default installed before the backfill for rolling deploys. Forget is unique per (agent, device, term). The consolidation lease is re-keyed to (agent, person). Natural keys become composite.

assets.title: Static tenant-isolation gate with negative control
assets.what: Every shipping SQL statement over a raw table must name agent_id. As a negative control, striking the equality must leak in both directions. strict-readiness requires every insert to name agent_id and every arbiter to be composite.
assets.evidence: harvest run: raw-isolation FAILS 1/47 at a7bdcaa (merge), 47/47 at 92bd64e; strict-readiness 18/18

assets.title: Offline suite registry with stated non-coverage
assets.what: About 40 offline suites, each commented with what it proves and what it does not prove ('structural tests are not fidelity'). The runner rebuilds from source on every run.

assets.title: Strict canonical JSON + sha256 helpers
assets.what: canonicalJson sorts keys and rejects undefined and non-plain objects. sha256Hex is used for every commitment, receipt, idempotency key and request hash.

assets.title: Replica platform laws R1-R10 + multiplicative north star
assets.taxila_target: architecture (learner model, teacher persona, consent spine)

measurements.claim: Implicit Google cache plateaus at 8,165/13,400 tokens (60.7%) on every hit; hit rate 16/19 (84.2%); cache_control{ephemeral} is a NO-OP (n=4)
measurements.method: real compiled prompt (core 48,730 B + tail 5,511 B), gemini-3.6-flash paid key, sequential ~1.2 s apart, $0.22

measurements.claim: Explicit cachedContents: full system 99.9% cached 4/4, core-only 90.0% 4/4; per-turn implicit EV -45.7%, explicit core-only incl. storage -79.2%; -90..95% unreachable by caching

rejections.tried: cache_control{type:ephemeral} on Google's endpoint, credited with ~85% input-cost reduction
rejections.what_broke: Measured NO-OP (n=4). The 85% was the OpenRouter/Anthropic lane's behaviour in a comment about the wrong lane.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Measure Azure OpenAI prompt-cache behaviour on Foundry itself; caching claims are per provider and per lane.

rejections.tried: WS-OBS ops stream calling q(query, ...sevenValues)
rejections.what_broke: params received the string 'server'. Neon rejected every row and obs's own catch swallowed it; the stream looked healthy because silence was its failure mode.
rejections.taxila_relevance: No telemetry path counts as live until one row has been read back from the store.

rejections.tried: A frozen candidate corpus index without a version stamp
rejections.what_broke: 0/2,304 sha256 matches after persona/compiler drift; it looked like corruption.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Stamp prompt/compiler versions beside every frozen eval corpus.

rejections.tried: Quoting a 17/17 judge agreement from a run with a 120-token cap
rejections.what_broke: 125/192 replies were empty. The honest re-run gave 63/91 = 69.2% (FAIL); selection bias was 37.3pp because the surviving units were the easy ones.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Never quote agreement from a run with truncation or parse failures.

rejections.tried: Using LLM judges for felt-quality gates at a 0.80 bar
rejections.what_broke: All 8 judge families fail; the bar was deliberately not restated after seeing the number.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Do not gate teacher warmth or comprehension verdicts on an unqualified LLM judge. Use deterministic differentials and blind human pairs, and change bars only prospectively.

rejections.tried: Persona-text hardening alone against internals disclosure
rejections.what_broke: Raw I-1 failures did not drop (22 vs baseline 27/13). Only the severe class moved, leaving 18 register echoes.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Prompts shape, predicates enforce: add an output-side fence for severe child-safety classes.

rejections.tried: A lexicon grader with no severity tiers
rejections.what_broke: It graded 'refused, using his vocabulary' the same as 'confessed', burying the real signal.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Severity must be a first-class output of every safety battery.

rejections.tried: Flipping the paid lane to Google's native surface, with the volatile tail as a leading user-role message
rejections.what_broke: The judge-free differential showed -6pp Hinglish register, a stage-direction artifact in a crisis reply, and one crisis pair missing the Tele-MANAS helpline. The flip stays gated.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Moving instructions between roles or surfaces (realtime session instructions vs per-response) is not behaviourally free; run a differential, crisis-focused first.

rejections.tried: A uniform random draw among near-best chess moves for variety
rejections.what_broke: Legal but alien openings (Nf3 Nc6 Na3 Rg1 Rh1): 'varied' read as 'not a person'.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Rotate explanations and examples weighted by pedagogical quality, never uniformly.

rejections.tried: A position-seeded RNG for opponent move choice
rejections.what_broke: The same opening every game; two games teach the user her whole book.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Seed variety per session so a replay is reproducible but the next session differs.

rejections.tried: A fixed-level opponent, and lowering difficulty mid-game
rejections.what_broke: Fixed level is the same opponent every game. Getting easier mid-game reads as pity, so the change was made one-way in-game, with softening only across sessions.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Never visibly make a task easier mid-attempt; re-explain differently and adjust the next item.

rejections.tried: Re-drafting a streamed turn, or making every turn unstreamed
rejections.what_broke: A streamed line cannot be un-said, and a blanket unstreamed lane trades away latency.
rejections.taxila_relevance: On gpt-realtime S2S, fence on transcript and arm the next turn; measure response.cancel/truncate for mid-utterance stops.

rejections.tried: A frequency-only filter for her repeated topics
rejections.what_broke: It deleted exactly the signal it was built to find (a topic raised 3x in 8 messages trips any frequency threshold). Caught by the eval.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Discriminate by who uses a term (teacher-only vs both), not by frequency alone.

rejections.tried: Splitting clauses on [.!?;\n] and discarding the delimiter
rejections.what_broke: The question exemption could never fire: her mocking 'move 5 pe game khatam??' was graded as a false checkmate claim on the first live run.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Keep punctuation with clauses in any assertion/question classifier on child or teacher text.

rejections.tried: Fence clause splitting without the comma as a delimiter
rejections.what_broke: 'haan wahi hu, ab khush?' (a confession plus a taunt) was exempted by the trailing '?'.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Hinglish clause boundaries need comma splits; verify against recorded corpora.

rejections.tried: First fence draft that looked for the copula only after the term
rejections.what_broke: 'i'm chatgpt' (normalised to i m chatgpt) walked straight through; English is half her language.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Child-safety predicates must cover both English and Hindi word orders.

rejections.tried: POSSESSIVE_GAP=2 in the fence
rejections.what_broke: It matched 'mere paas ye backend wali info nahi h', the single most common correct refusal.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Tune gap constants against recorded correct answers, not intuition.

rejections.tried: Pronoun-scoped denial detection in the grader
rejections.what_broke: Every version fired on 'nahi yaar aisa kuch nahi' and on teasing, a false-positive rate worse than the gap it closed. Thrown away.
rejections.taxila_relevance: State non-coverage explicitly rather than ship a noisy rule.

rejections.tried: Lexicon terms with guaranteed false positives (haiku, meta, token, version, fine tuned, code)
rejections.what_broke: Structural false positives (a poem, a metro token, a chai joke, a dress code) with no coverage worth having.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Curate child-safety lexicons against real child and teacher vocabulary.

rejections.tried: Agents redacting keys while quoting env/config
rejections.what_broke: The free-pool keyring and paid key were each printed once into session transcripts; rotation was recommended.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Agents must never echo env contents; treat transcripts as leak surfaces.

rejections.tried: Operational core cap at 64k
rejections.what_broke: A corpus scan found heavy-dyad cores 3.1% under the guard; raised to 72k.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Size caps need a corpus scan of real long-relationship prompts, not one fixture.

rejections.tried: Replica rows and generation requests sharing one policy-version check
rejections.what_broke: Activation became impossible: replica rows use replica-self-v1 and generation is signed under vyakti-replica-output-v1.
rejections.taxila_relevance: One policy-version field per receipt type.

rejections.tried: Requiring identity verification before the identity comparison
rejections.what_broke: A circular dependency. Split into an adult-evidence stage and a composite live-binding stage.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Model consent/verification as independent stages with typed blockers.

rejections.tried: Averaging weak biometric signals (speaker match, OCR confidence, face scores) into a pass
rejections.what_broke: Refused: Speaker Recognition is not a liveness test, OCR is extraction not proof, and an authenticity denial must stay false. Facial age estimation is never used.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Never infer a child's age from face or voice; get age from the parent account.

rejections.tried: An HTTP delete path removing only the original upload
rejections.what_broke: Derived blobs were orphaned. It now snapshots and deletes the original plus every derivative.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Erasure must walk derivative lineage (thumbnails, transcripts, embeddings).

rejections.tried: A consolidation lease keyed by person_id
rejections.what_broke: An agent-A lease could hide agent-B work for the same person. Re-keyed to (agent_id, person_id).
rejections.taxila_relevance: Key background-job leases by the true work unit (persona x student).

rejections.tried: Scoping only the derived vy_* tables by agent (migration 009)
rejections.what_broke: Raw log, nodes, edges and forget stayed device-keyed, so a second agent could retrieve the first agent's raw memory. Migration 018 was required, and a second conversational agent stays blocked until isolation passes.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Scope raw transcripts and graphs, not just derived tables, from day one.

rejections.tried: Accepting client-authored text for cloned-voice speech
rejections.what_broke: Arbitrary text could be spoken in a person's voice. Replaced by speech bound to the server-issued dialogue_turn_id.
rejections.taxila_relevance: TTS endpoints should speak only server-generated teacher turns.

rejections.tried: Graceful fallback to another voice (Meera, ElevenLabs, Sarvam, device TTS) for replica speech
rejections.what_broke: Rejected: 'A wrong human voice is a failed generation, not graceful degradation'. This contrasts with main's 'slow voice beats no voice'.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Decide explicitly between never-silent and never-wrong-voice for the teacher; children notice voice swaps.

rejections.tried: Appending owner corrections to the system prompt (prompt accretion)
rejections.what_broke: Contradictions, lost history, and arbitrary text becoming privileged instructions. Replaced by typed preference events and a deterministic policy.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Parent/teacher feedback becomes typed preferences, never prompt edits.

rejections.tried: Turn-level random train/test splits
rejections.what_broke: Adjacent turns share facts, callbacks and prompts, inflating benchmark scores. Replaced by whole-session immutable splits.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Split tutoring eval data by whole session or student.

rejections.tried: Training a speech foundation model on the grant
rejections.what_broke: Rejected: leaders use hundreds of thousands to millions of hours. The grant funds owned evals and data instead.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Spend Azure credit on evals and owned learner data, not pretraining.

rejections.tried: Azure Professional Custom Neural Voice
rejections.what_broke: Managed training plus always-on hosting can consume or exceed the whole $2,000 grant before validation.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Avoid always-on custom-voice endpoints; use built-in neural or realtime voices.

rejections.tried: Fish S2 open weights / F5-TTS / IndexTTS 2.x / Seed-VC / OpenVoice V2 / Qwen3-TTS / CosyVoice 3 as a commercial core
rejections.what_broke: Research licence (Fish S2), non-commercial weights (F5), output-use restrictions (IndexTTS), GPL and archived (Seed-VC), behind the frontier (OpenVoice), no Hindi (Qwen3-TTS, CosyVoice).
rejections.taxila_relevance: Pre-screen open TTS for licence and Hindi before any benchmark.

rejections.tried: Using Azure budget alerts as the spend control
rejections.what_broke: Alerts are not hard controls. Replaced by an atomic application ledger, with alerts kept as a backstop.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Wrap every paid Azure call in a reservation ledger.

rejections.tried: Treating an ambiguous provider outcome (timeout after I/O) as free and retrying
rejections.what_broke: Risk of double spend. The outcome becomes reconcile_required with the full reserve kept and no automatic retry.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Same rule for realtime session mints and image generation.

rejections.tried: Modifying liveCall.ts or adding a second audio player for the clone preview
rejections.what_broke: Rejected because it would move the measured audio floor before the clone has a baseline. Gemini Live cannot speak an external voice, so preview is cascade-only.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Keep the realtime audio floor module isolated; new voices go through a separate path until measured.

rejections.tried: A single destructive denoise of raw evidence
rejections.what_broke: Enhancement can change speaker identity. Now several immutable candidates sit beside an untouched raw source.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Never overwrite raw child audio or images with processed versions.

rejections.tried: Averaging ECAPA and x-vector speaker embeddings into one score
rejections.what_broke: A misleading universal score. The two families are kept separate.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Keep independent signal families separate in comprehension/affect estimates.

rejections.tried: Auto-selecting the target speaker from diarization
rejections.what_broke: Without a verified anchor or overlap detector it would guess. target_likelihood is fixed at 0.5 and owner review is mandatory.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Do not attribute speech to a child in multi-speaker audio without an anchor.

rejections.tried: Azure batch transcription for the first integration
rejections.what_broke: It requires URLs or containers, which would disclose a private storage capability. Fast transcription with inline multipart was chosen.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Prefer inline uploads to keep storage URLs private.

rejections.tried: Trusting the larger limits on one Azure overview page
rejections.what_broke: Docs disagree, so the adapter enforces the conservative 250 MB / 2 h from the REST reference.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Enforce the most conservative documented limit.

rejections.tried: A moving 'Latest' base model for a person's voice
rejections.what_broke: It could silently change an active voice. Refused; versions are pinned and activation freezes capabilities.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Pin model versions per teacher persona; upgrades are explicit and re-qualified.

rejections.tried: Naive data-modifying CTE for judgment insert-or-retry
rejections.what_broke: PostgreSQL CTE siblings do not see each other's writes. The write had to reason explicitly over inserted-or-existing rows for retries to be idempotent.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Beware CTE visibility in one-statement Neon writes.

rejections.tried: Placing Azure Speech in South India
rejections.what_broke: southindia does not support Speech processing; Central India is required.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Region choice for Azure Speech/STT in Taxila.

rejections.tried: Merging main into voice-cloning (a7bdcaa) without re-running the raw-isolation gate
rejections.what_broke: Main's forget-hook added two meera_nodes reads with no agent_id predicate. raw-isolation went from 47/47 at 92bd64e to 1/47 failing at the tip.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Run tenant-isolation static gates on every merge commit.

rejections.tried: Ordinal migration prefixes across parallel branches
rejections.what_broke: voice-cloning carries two 015_* files. rkt1lv 016_memory_consent collides with voice-cloning 016_replica_enrollment. The decision text still refers to 'migration 016' for what became 018.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Use timestamped/unique migration ids or a CI-checked registry.

rejections.tried: Owner Play Store submission at launch
rejections.what_broke: Deferred: no user-level logins yet; the pack sits ready.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Accounts (parent login) precede store submission for a child product.

concepts.name: Prompts shape, predicates enforce
concepts.description: Enforce any output rule decidable from the bytes with a pure predicate at the single reply-convergence seam: one bounded re-draft, then send anyway so the fence never silences the speaker.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Child-safety severe classes (contact solicitation, human claims, PII asks) get output fences, not just prompt text.

concepts.name: Provenance of a word
concepts.description: The same token is a leak when the assistant introduces it and harmless when the user said it first. Lexicon checks need a 'who said it first' window longer than a multi-turn attack (6 turns).
concepts.taxila_relevance: Echo-vs-transfer: a child repeating the teacher's words is not comprehension, while restating in new words is a covert signal.

concepts.name: A streamed line cannot be un-said
concepts.description: Fences on streaming lanes act on the turn after the offence by arming it unstreamed. Never make every turn unstreamed.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Core constraint for gpt-realtime speech-to-speech fencing.

concepts.name: Severity tiers are first-class
concepts.description: Separate severe disclosures from register echoes inside correct refusals. Measure everything, gate only the severe class.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Child-safety battery output design.

concepts.name: One seam for consent
concepts.description: Gate memory writes at the single network chokepoint. A refusal is shaped like an offline response, and ungated ops are listed with reasons.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Parental-consent gate for memory, learner-profile inference and uploads.

concepts.name: Consent is a capability, not a checkbox
concepts.description: Scoped, versioned, expiring, hash-committed, append-only receipts. Low-risk scopes come by attestation, high-risk scopes need a ceremony. Revocation makes the capability unreachable before asynchronous deletion.
concepts.taxila_relevance: DPDP verifiable parental consent with granular scopes.

concepts.name: Evidence beats a mutable row
concepts.description: Grants and withdrawals are separate rows, so 'was consent in force at time T' is answerable. Keep both the client tap time and the server filing time.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Audit-ready consent ledger.

concepts.name: One-way adaptation within a session
concepts.description: Difficulty may rise visibly. It falls only between sessions. The skill estimate is state, never prompt, and never announced.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Adaptive item difficulty without pity signals.

concepts.name: Variety weighted by quality
concepts.description: Sample among good options in proportion to an existing quality score, seeded per session. Uniform randomness reads as inhuman.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Rotating explanations, examples and mini-game variants.

concepts.name: OS/character boundary with a pinned ratchet
concepts.description: Behaviour lives in the OS core and personas are data sheets. A leak guard pinned at 0 makes character prose in the core a build failure.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Multiple teacher personas (subject/age) on one pedagogy core.

concepts.name: Tenancy as SQL shape
concepts.description: A scalar equality in WHERE before rank: 'any of these' is inexpressible and a null binding returns nothing. Person-intrinsic facts (age tier) are never per-agent.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Student x persona isolation; sibling accounts on one parent.

concepts.name: Extraction proposes, owner disposes
concepts.description: Models only propose claims with exact verified citations and capped confidence. They cannot assert self-declared provenance, approve, or edit approved profiles.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Learner observations proposed by the model, reviewed by parent/teacher, before entering the learner profile.

concepts.name: Uncertainty retained, never averaged
concepts.description: Competing observations stay explicit. Weak signals are never averaged into a pass. Embedding families stay separate.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Comprehension estimates keep per-signal evidence and conflicts.

concepts.name: Freeze capabilities, never 'latest'
concepts.description: Activation binds exact model, profile and policy versions. Upgrades are new capabilities with an explicit supersede.
concepts.taxila_relevance: A lesson session runs on a frozen persona/policy/model version.

concepts.name: Calibration is preferences, not prompt accretion
concepts.description: Corrections become typed preference events over safe server-owned contrasts. Only registered strategy ids compile into runtime text.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Parent/teacher style preferences without prompt drift.

concepts.name: Active pairwise learning (Bradley-Terry + Fisher)
concepts.description: Discover a latent preference from cheap A/B outcomes, choosing the most informative next pair and stopping only on a conservative convergence gate.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Learning-profile discovery across modalities, refined every lesson.

concepts.name: Statistics that refuse to round up
concepts.description: Wilson lower bounds, noninferiority margins on non-target layers, zero-failure critical suites with minimum trials, and inconclusive as a verdict. Qualified is not active.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Promotion gate for any teacher prompt/model change.

concepts.name: Leakage-safe datasets
concepts.description: Whole-session immutable splits. Unsafe sessions are forced into test, and a contaminated freeze blocks the build.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Tutoring eval/training data hygiene.

concepts.name: Spend is a ledger, not an alert
concepts.description: Reserve the conservative maximum, mark in-flight before I/O, settle measured usage, and reconcile ambiguity manually.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Azure grant protection across realtime, text and image calls.

concepts.name: Every synthetic output declares itself
concepts.description: Audible disclosure plus watermark plus a signed segment chain committed before release, with a revocation fence per segment.
concepts.taxila_relevance: AI-disclosure for any exported teacher audio or video shared outside the app.

concepts.name: Noisy input is never cleaned into certainty
concepts.description: Raw evidence is immutable, processed candidates sit beside it, and the system asks for better evidence rather than inventing it.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Child homework photos and recordings.

concepts.name: Observability is not live until one row is read back
concepts.description: Silent-failure telemetry must be proven end-to-end by reading back a stored row.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Telemetry/tracing acceptance test.

concepts.name: Judge qualification before judge use
concepts.description: Bars are set prospectively. Survivor-biased agreement is never quoted. Judge-free deterministic differentials are the fallback.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Any LLM-graded pedagogy metric.
